verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Marqeta's system sends funding requests at transaction time for approve/deny decisions, sends webhooks, and supports merchant-based authorization controls. None of it documents what context an authorization event carries: merchant name, MCC, enhanced merchant data, wallet or entry-mode details, partial-approval signals, or incremental-auth signals. Merchant-group spend controls are a related feature, not event payload context, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, every authorization event carries decision-grade context — merchant name and MCC, enhanced merchant data, wallet and entry-mode details, partial-approval and incremental-auth signals
